paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot, chapter 4, halakhah 2: he and Rav Tachlifa bar Ami were sitting before Rabbi Lazar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The matching Guggenheimer digital paragraph is in Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot 4:3 and names Huna bar Chinena with Rav Tachlifa bar Imi before Rabbi Lazar. Hyman’s supplied 4:2 locator and bar Ami form are retained alongside that comparison.

The whole Guggenheimer Maaserot 4:3 paragraph names Huna bar Chinena and Rav Tachlifa bar Imi sitting before Rabbi Lazar. Hyman’s 4:2 locator and bar Ami form remain as supplied.
